rule: Fields are defined only when scientific meaning, provenance, applicability and assessment mapping are explicit. Never pad to 650 with placeholder variables.

fields.name: Pivotal trial registration identifier
fields.definition: Registry identifier of the trial supporting the application

fields.name: Prespecified primary endpoint
fields.definition: Primary outcome and analysis specification established before outcome unblinding
fields.source: Registry history and protocol/statistical analysis plan

fields.name: Primary endpoint estimate and uncertainty
fields.definition: Reported effect size with confidence interval and analysis population
fields.source: Trial results publication or clinical study report

fields.name: Serious adverse event incidence
fields.definition: Serious adverse events by randomized arm with exposure denominator
fields.source: Clinical study report or ClinicalTrials.gov results

fields.name: Manufacturing inspection and quality evidence
fields.definition: Documented CMC readiness and known inspection or quality deficiencies, with undisclosed matters explicitly unknown
fields.applicability: NDA or BLA under FDA review
fields.source: FDA public records and company regulatory disclosures

fields.name: Point-in-time evidence cutoff
fields.definition: Timestamp after which evidence is excluded from prospective or retrospective reconstruction

fields.name: Comparable FDA decisions
fields.definition: Prior decisions selected using predeclared indication, modality, endpoint and review criteria
fields.source: FDA approval letters, review documents, CRL disclosures

fields.name: Disease natural history and unmet need
fields.definition: Documented baseline prognosis, standard care and clinically meaningful unmet need
fields.source: Peer-reviewed natural-history studies and treatment guidelines

note: Assessment IDs are proposed cross-references pending reconciliation with canonical 40-assessment catalog; do not assume confirmed mappings.
